title: •Wes Janson
caption: •Wes Janson (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While piloting Red 3, it gains {nav} and Wes draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While aboard a starship or vehicle, its total weapon destiny is +1; if with Jek and it hits a target, opponent loses 1 Force from Reserve Deck.
lore: Served for many years as a gunner with friend Jek Porkins in the Tierfon Yellow Aces. Expert marksmanship helped the Alliance earn some of its earliest victories.

notes: Sheet group: Everything else. Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box empty; deploy 2 / forfeit 5 (same as printed). Yellow LS pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2}. Inline icon after 'it gains' is the red square with an astromech dome = Nav Computer → {nav}; the STUB READS IT AS 'shields' — wrong. 'Red 3' not italic on the slip. Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior (printed card: Warrior only). Rebel. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Alexander Sheynis' / 'Berkeley V-Lite 2005' → credit_bottom. Wiki default 'Wes Janson' is the Glossary 2.0 errata; printed face = 'Wes Janson (Original)' (Hoth-L-wesjanson-decipher-archive.gif, 350 px, src); Hoth-L-wesjanson.gif (350, same face) also downloaded. Lore matches the wiki and the scans (350 px only). Copyright 1996 (Hoth) legible enough. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4-L-wesjanson-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre also exists).
